description: Ascendancy monster definitions and drop tables. Values are nerfed from LoK source data (~50-80% reduction on Build/Research SP) to match Castle L26-30 ×1.30/×1.50 multiplier curve and World Speed Factor 2.0. Pacing target: F2P Endgame (Castle L25 + T4 + 6 Treasure Slots) in 3-5 months.

balance_notes.speedup_separation: Solo monsters drop ONLY Train/Recover SPs. Build/Research SPs are gated behind Treasure Goblin (rare solo spawn) and Dragon Rallies. This is the central balance lever — keeps alliance content meaningful.
balance_notes.drop_quantity_reduction: vs LoK original: Solo monster SP quantity ~50% nerfed, Dragon Build/Research SP quantity ~80% nerfed. Probabilities mostly preserved or upped to 100% for guaranteed-feel.
balance_notes.treasure_goblin_role: F2P-essential. Rare spawn (1-2 per kingdom sector per hour), 30min despawn. Guaranteed Build+Research SP drops. Solo path to alliance-equivalent content.
balance_notes.charm_drops: Charms drop ONLY from Orc/Skeleton/Golem (Solo standard monsters). Per §14.14: 4-tier rarity distribution by monster level. Lv 0-3: Normal-dominated (no Legendary). Lv 4-6: Normal+Epic mix (no Legendary). Lv 7-8: Epic-dominated, 20-25% Legendary chance. Lv 9-10: 50/50 Epic/Legendary. Stat category is uniform random across 8 categories. Other monsters (Goblin/Deathkar/Dragons/Magdar) have their own valuable drop pools and do NOT drop charms.
balance_notes.gems_drops: All monsters drop GEMS (per §14.15). Solo monsters: 15% chance × 10/30/40 by tier. Goblin: 50% chance × 30/50/75. Deathkar: 30% chance × 50/100. Dragons: 50% chance × 100/200/300 by level. Magdar: 100% chance × 500/1000/2000. Calibrated for active F2P income of 80-200 GEMS/day, supporting the no-pay-to-win pillar.
